name: Phoenix Subdomain
body:
Associated Domains: Fire, Sun

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the fire resistance ability of the Fire domain or the nimbus of light ability of the Sun domain.

Fast Healing (Su)

At 8th level, you can touch a creature, granting them fast healing 3 for a number of rounds equal to ½ your cleric level. You can use this power once per day at 8th level, plus one additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd- healing flames, 4th-healing warmth.
